query:
select id from work_locator
         where btrim(regexp_replace(lower(label), '[^[:alnum:]]+', ' ', 'g')) = $1
            or exists (select 1 from unnest(aliases) a
                       where btrim(regexp_replace(lower(a), '[^[:alnum:]]+', ' ', 'g')) = $1)
         order by locator limit 1
